name: Arles, Roman and Romanesque Monuments
description: Arles, in Provence in southern France, packs two thousand years of history into its old centre. You can walk from a 1st-century B.C. Roman arena and theatre to underground galleries beneath the old forum, then to the ruined baths of Constantine. Nearby, the Romanesque church of Saint-Trophime has a carved portal and a serene cloister, and the Alyscamps is an ancient burial ground.
